label: Momentum-tilted preference variant; not a validated improvement
selection_provenance: Chosen for user preference after all retrospective outcomes were exposed. Historical apparent gains do not justify this choice as a validated improvement.
formula: Frozen dual_w0.01 base plus0.05 times centered within-sector trailing professor-mode SIP-profit percentile times invested-budget fraction, with original missing/event/trading-activity guards. No retraining or changed underlying model.
weight_boundary: 0.05 is an additive coefficient, not a 5percent total-model share. Variant does not establish majority weighting of professor factors or add five annual-return/fundamental features.
frozen_audit: Implementation and overlap audit only. Always ineligible, never relabelled later. No backfilled forecast. No future outcomes read.

gates: Full champion and candidate scored on identical verified daily inputs and sector universe
Every required market input has a provenance receipt and split/bonus adjustment audit, with no unknown critical corporate-action or suspension coverage
Inputs and output frozen and hashed before the first forward contribution and before any outcome
Actual UTC observation timestamp separated from market as-of date; no backfill
Same execution, residual-cash, cashflow, cost, profile and outcome definitions for both streams

prospective_objective.primary: Equal-weight average of five feature-alignment measures for sector Top3: one-year price return,3Y CAGR,strict supported5Y CAGR,recorded-high recency,trailing professor-mode whole-share SIP profit. These are an explicit project lens, not paper-prescribed weights or independent factors.
prospective_objective.alignment_measure: Within-date/profile/sector percentiles over the full eligible common feature cohort. Higher is better; reverse high age. For each feature, compare only sectors where all three selected stocks in both strategies have that feature. Average paired sector differences then date differences. Missing factors are unavailable, never zero.
prospective_objective.coverage: At least20matched complete sectors per feature/date and at least80percent of paired eligible monthly decision dates; otherwise inconclusive. Report excluded coverage and feature support.
prospective_objective.overlap: For >=5eligible peer sectors, top3set change fraction, mean shared names, overlap and changed-sector list. Stable ISIN boundary tie-break; report boundary tie counts.

noninferiority_limits.portfolio_coverage: At least80percent matched eligible monthly decision dates; never silently remove/reweight a blocked selected stock. Sparse portfolio evidence cannot justify adoption.

review.daily_logging_monthly_primary: Archive every eligible daily forecast; primary dates are first eligible trading-day issue each calendar month, fixed before outcomes. Overlapping12month outcomes are dependent.
review.earliest: Only after12distinct monthly decision dates have fully matured; roughly24months after first eligible issue, not12months after this stale registration.
review.uncertainty: Paired365/730day circular date-block bootstrap,4000resamples, report intervals and available effective support; blocks exceeding span unavailable. Thresholds are operational preference limits, not proof of statistical noninferiority. No automatic adoption.
review.multiple_testing: Exactly one candidate frozen; any new weights, candidate or objective requires a new registration. Retrospective tables remain exposed diagnostics only.

recording: Separate append-only data-only branch, ordinary fast-forward pushes. No edits to existing prospective-ledger records, original protocol or daily automation.
product: Keep model rank unchanged. A separate labelled momentum lens is a later product option once full point-in-time factor definitions and fresh adjusted inputs are verified; do not invent fundamentals.
public_claim: No claim of validated superiority, investment returns or majority professor-factor weighting.
